Can use all four races’ technology items and golems.
Unlocks cloning, soul, teleportation and weaving recipes.

monsterperspective.race.vampire.trait_3: Invisible without armor or held items, with no particles.

monsterperspective.race.arthropod.techno: Checks applicability and enchantment conflicts, preserving existing enchantments.
Protection III / Feather Falling IV / Fire Protection III / Unbreaking III
Fortune II / Looting II / Silk Touch / Sharpness III
Combine silk with a suitable item in a crafting grid to enchant it.
Combine silk with minerals to craft eight enchanted silks.
monsterperspective.race.arthropod.trait_: Right-click in the air with a glass bottle to obtain venom, a fermented spider eye substitute.
Spider eyes do not poison you; melee attacks poison targets.
Takes extra Bane of Arthropods damage and slowness.
Climb walls; sneak to stop climbing.
Spider model; hitbox is 1 block high and 1.4 blocks wide.
monsterperspective.race.arthropod.story: Weave a web from which no prey escapes.
monsterperspective.race.arthropod.name: Arthropod
monsterperspective.race.enderman.technol: Infinite pearls work in Ender IO travel devices when installed.
Infinite pearl: throw ender pearls repeatedly with a one-second cooldown.
The binding pearl breaks if its target dies or is unloaded.
Binding pearl: bind a living target, then use again to swap places.
Teleport scroll: mark a location, then use again to return and consume it.
monsterperspective.race.enderman.trait_3: Right-click in the air with an off-hand knife to trade 2 health for an ender pearl.
monsterperspective.race.enderman.trait_2: Takes damage from water, rain and splash water bottles.
monsterperspective.race.enderman.trait_1: Maximum health ×2; height and viewpoint increase to three blocks.
monsterperspective.race.enderman.story: Cross the rift with the way home in hand.
monsterperspective.race.enderman.name: Enderman
monsterperspective.race.skeleton.technol: Equip a filled soul bottle in a Curios charm slot for +50% speed.
Bone golems can revive after a five-minute cooldown.
Bone + filled soul bottle → bone golem parts.
Carry an empty soul bottle when killing a villager, illager, pig, cow or sheep.
monsterperspective.race.skeleton.trait_5: Drinking milk at full health grants a bone; floats in water and cannot swim.
monsterperspective.race.skeleton.trait_4: Milk grants golden apple regeneration and absorption.
monsterperspective.race.skeleton.trait_3: Healing and harming are reversed; no hunger, but can still eat.
monsterperspective.race.skeleton.trait_2: Burns in sunlight without headgear; takes extra Smite damage.
monsterperspective.race.skeleton.story: A hollow frame holding an undying soul.
monsterperspective.race.skeleton.name: Skeleton
